data.gender_notes: Maitrik is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Maitrik is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘maitri’ which means ‘friendship’, ‘amity’ or ‘love’. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the name Maitrik is bestowed upon those who possess the qualities of compassion, kindness, and love towards all beings. The name Maitrik carries the meaning “Friendliness, Amity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Maitrik usually hope their child will grow to embody friendliness, amity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages love and compassion towards all

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maitrik total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Maitrik holds a significant cultural impact in Hindu society, as it represents the values of love, affection, and friendship. In Hindu traditions, the act of naming a child is believed to influence their personality and future. By giving a child the name Maitrik, parents are often expressing their hopes and aspirations for their child to grow up to be a compassionate, kind, and loving individual.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Maitrik holds great significance as it symbolizes the unity and interconnectedness of all beings. Hinduism teaches that every soul is eternal and that we are all part of the divine consciousness. The name Maitrik serves as a reminder of this profound truth and encourages us to cultivate love and compassion towards all beings, recognizing the divine spark within each one. By embodying the qualities of Maitrik, we are able to deepen our spiritual connection to the universe and live a more meaningful and fulfilling life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Maitrik signifies the embodiment of love and friendship. It represents the deep connection and bond between individuals or the universe and its beings. The name is inspired by the Sanskrit word 'maitri', meaning friendship or love.

historical_references.reference: Maitri Upanishad - A Hindu scripture which is part of the Atharva Veda, expounding the spiritual significance of 'Maitri' or love and friendship.

Mahabharata - A Hindu epic where 'Maitri' is mentioned as the name of a sage who gave important advice to Bheeshma during the Kurukshetra War. This sage was revered for his wisdom and his name signified 'friendship'.

The spiritual aspect of the name is also reflected in the use of 'Maitrik' as a term for expressing love and kindness towards all beings and the natural world.
